description:
Full timeframe continuity (FTFC, Truth #2): is the last sale above (up) or below (down)
    the open of every timeframe in the group, or mixed (conflict)?

    Returns per-timeframe side, color and aggression (above an open: buyers more aggressive,
    willing to buy at higher prices; below: sellers more aggressive), state up/down/mixed,
    override (day and 60 agree against the week/month) and the profit-taking note (only the
    60 red). FTFC is a state, not a signal.

group.description: standard = M W D 60 (default), intraday = 60 30 15 5, investing = Y Q M W, all = Y Q M W D 60 30 15 5.
group.title: Group

opens.description: Open price of the CURRENT bar per timeframe, e.g. {"M": 650.1, "W": 662.0, "D": 665.2, "60": 666.0}.
opens.title: Opens
